# Getting started with Teamboard

Teamboard keeps your team's plans on boards. Each board belongs to a Space,
and everyone you invite to a Space can see its boards.

## Create your first Space

1. Sign in to Teamboard.
2. Select **New Space** in the sidebar.
3. Give the Space a name your team will recognize, such as "Marketing" or
   "Platform team".

## Add a board

Open the Space and select **Add board**. A board starts with three lists:
To do, Doing and Done. Rename them or add more lists as your work needs.
